question:
This industrial part is left-right symmetric about the vertical centre line of the image, so the two halves should look identical. One side may carry a defect that its mirror counterpart does not have. The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] in [0, 1] (origin top-left). At most one of them contains the defect. Which region contains it?
(A) [0.7276, 0.2891, 0.8886, 0.4501]
(B) [0.1114, 0.2891, 0.2724, 0.4501]
(C) [0.6787, 0.0660, 0.8397, 0.2270]
(D) The two halves match; no defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.

</tool_call>

Now that I have cropped region A and saved it as [img2], I need to compare it with the corresponding region on the opposite side of the image. To do this, I will crop the same region from the left side of the image.

The region A is [0.7276, 0.2891, 0.8886, 0.4501] in the original image [img1]. Since the image is symmetric about the vertical center line, the corresponding region on the left side would be [0.1114, 0.2891, 0.2724, 0.4501], which is region B. Let's crop region B.

</tool_call>

Now I have cropped region B and saved it as [img3]. By comparing [img2] (region A) and [img3] (region B), I can see that they are different. In [img3], there is a small, distinct object (possibly a defect) that is not present in [img2]. The object in [img3] appears to be a small, metallic-looking piece with a slight bend, which is not mirrored in [img2].

To be thorough, I should check the other regions as well to ensure that this is indeed the defect and not something else. Let's check region C.

Now I have cropped region C and saved it as [img4]. Comparing [img4] with the corresponding region on the opposite side (which would be [0.1114, 0.0660, 0.2724, 0.2270]), I can see that [img4] appears to be symmetric with its counterpart. The weave pattern in [img4] matches the corresponding region on the left side.

To confirm, I should now compare [img2] and [img3] directly to ensure that region B indeed contains the defect. Let's overlay them to see the difference clearly.

<tool_call>
{"name": "overlay_images", "arguments": {"background": "[img2]", "foreground": "[img3]", "x": 0.0, "y": 0.0}}

After overlaying [img3] onto [img2], it is clear that there is a distinct difference. The object in [img3] (region B) is not present in [img2] (region A). The object in [img3] appears to be a defect, as it does not match the surrounding weave pattern and is asymmetrical with its counterpart on the other side.

Therefore, the correct answer is B.

<answer> B </answer>
